text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking on the academy grounds,
I heard shouting coming from the direction of the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna!
Eat waaaaaay more carrot ice cream!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now passionately recruiting fellow heroes—!
Let's all defeat evil togetheeeer—!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Preeeeez!!
Pay more attention to meeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Splendid!! I have received your feelings loud and clear!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, anyone else?!
Let's shout to our hearts' content from the rooftop!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The culprit behind the commotion is none other than—
choice_data_list: Bakushin O!? What in the world are you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around,
a whole crowd of spectators had gathered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I need to settle this before it turns into a major incident—
With that in mind, I hurried up to the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san.
Why are you so out of breath?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
I'm so glad you asked!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was here, receiving the passionate feelings
of the students!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: At the academy, there's a tree hollow where you can vent feelings you can't tell anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: However! There are times when you want to share your feelings far and wide, times when you want everyone to hear them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And then it hit me! I just need to shout it
somewhere that gets a lot of attention!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
“And regarding the feelings you've confided in me,
as an honor student, I will give my all to help you!!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
When I really pumped myself up to clean the rooftop before,
it felt so utterly refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I've realized—screaming from high places
feels ridiculously amazing!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see. I understand your motive and reasoning,
but executing it without permission isn't commendable.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Members of the student council!
Have you come to praise my achievements!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As if, you fool.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What you're doing is nothing short of a nuisance.
If you understand that, pack up and leave immediately.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I-I object!
Listening to the students' voices is not a nuisance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Responding to every call is the class rep's duty...!
I won't leave until I've heard every single voice!"
choice_data_list: I have no choice but to drag them away by force.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I gave Sakura Bakushin O a push on the back and tried to leave the scene, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No waaaaayyyy!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As Class Rep, I will absolutely NOT go home
until I have heard every single one of your voices~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Listening to everyone's voices isn't a bad thing in itself, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A suggestion box app already exists.
Wouldn't that be sufficient?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's not even close to enough!
There are feelings that can only reach people through your own real voice!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Direct voices from the ground, huh... True, your point is valid.
—Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot permit this gathering,
but please continue listening to the students' voices in the future."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I fully intend to gather and listen to
even more voices myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa!! What an honor...!!
To be praised by the Student Council President herself—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I truly am a role model for the students!!
An Umamusume born to be Class Rep!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the gathering was broken up, Sakura Bakushin O
fired up with motivation for a new mission
after receiving a personal request from the President.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I mentioned that while doing it without permission wasn't good, maybe we could continue if we got permission now, to which—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, in that case, I shall head to the Chairwoman's office!
Going ASAP-ly, GOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O dashed off with tremendous momentum...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone!
I got it—permission from the Chairwoman herself!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What was that!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"‘Approved! Sounds quite interesting!’
is what was said!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
They made sure to emphasize that it must be done
at their designated date and time without disturbing others, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... Understood.
There should be no issue so long as we establish ground rules.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I think it's not half bad.
You and I might have occasion to make use of it too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Whatever it may be,
I'll take it all head-on!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you have any troubles, I shall tackle
their solution with my whole heart and soul!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
Just please don't cause any trouble."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O's proposal was met with great acclaim, and students with something to proclaim frequently visited the rooftop thereafter.
